scope: Backend merge; code-only checks. No live models, backend servers, SSH tunnels or SUMO/netconvert processes started.

conflict_resolution.crowdsim/core/simulation_runtime.py: Keep local during preset/observation/duration/performance settings and remote artificial society engine/binding/diagnostics.
conflict_resolution.crowdsim/infrastructure/websocket_server: Keep local requirement HTTP and preset entry points and remote artificial society submission/configure/attach checks.

compatibility: Existing run.sh and direct module commands, scenario/mode/ports and --restart-services remain available; SUMO 1.24.0/1.27.0 supported.
Existing .env untouched; shared SSH defaults restored to remote hyq, explicit user configuration still overrides defaults.
Optional experiment control startup/exit failures do not tear down original required services; explicit restart ownership and active-experiment checks remain strict.
Ordinary startup can reuse a legacy server with no performance endpoint (404); explicit performance monitoring still requires matching configuration.
Requirements without a model delegate to the original decision engine. Bound implemented modeling chains still enable their remote behavior.
Same requirement reset with omitted/empty model ID preserves the binding. Switching requirement without a model restores baseline LLM mode, sampling ranges, period and visual policy.
Reset preserves observation duration, seeds, local preset observer and performance settings. Frozen during presets reject unrelated model bindings before stopping the old run.
Remote session test double updated with local duration state; attach request IDs made monotonic to avoid object-ID reuse collisions.

unit_tests.command: PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 PYTHONPATH=tests:.:/tmp /opt/miniconda3/envs/sumo/bin/python -m pytest -p code_only_guard -p backend_merge_offline tests pedestrian_decision_skill/tests --tb=short -q
unit_tests.isolation: tests/code_only_guard.py blocks SUMO start, Popen, socket connects/listeners; temporary audit plugin blocks actual subprocess/socket calls even if test fixtures override mocks. Git commit metadata is replaced with frozen local-parent metadata in memory.

not_validated: Real model conversations and pedestrian decisions
